page.title: Arrive, read the keys and do everything without a mouse
page.lead: The headquarters of a sample institution. On the first visit, the welcome window shows the keys. In Avatar mode, everything works from the keyboard alone: M switches the mode, C opens the Co-Pilot, T the cohort chat, H the help, I the information and E enters the building. Mouse and touch still work.

sceneLabel.avatar: 3D headquarters with {count} buildings, in Avatar mode (third person).
sceneLabel.orbital: 3D headquarters with {count} buildings, in the Orbital view (from above).

page.about1: A single shortcut list feeds the keyboard, the HUD buttons, the welcome and the help: a key never shows on one screen and is missing on another.
page.about2: No shortcut fires while typing (in the chat, "t", "c", "m" and "h" are just text), nor with Ctrl, Cmd or Alt.
page.about3: A test checks that every HUD button has a key and appears in the help: a new action without a key blocks the PR.

guide.welcomeIntro: Here you learn by walking around a 3D city. These are the keys; at any time, press H to see this help again.
guide.welcomeIntroTouch: Here you learn by walking around a 3D city. This is how you move and use the campus; the help is in the Help button, at the top.

touch.move: Use the joystick, in the bottom corner, to walk and turn.
touch.buttons: The buttons at the top open the information, the Co-Pilot, the chat and the help.
touch.mode: Avatar walks around the city; Orbital shows everything from above (drag and pinch).

guide.foot: The mouse is optional: the on-screen buttons do the same as the keys.
guide.footTouch: On a computer, all of this also works from the keyboard.

chat.title: Cohort chat

copilot.title: Co-Pilot
copilot.intro: Ask about the campus. In the demo, the answers are ready-made; in the product, they come from the AI tutor.
copilot.placeholder: E.g.: how do I switch the mode?

answers.mode: Press M to switch between Avatar (you walk around the city) and Orbital (the view from above).
answers.chat: Press T to open the cohort chat. Enter sends, and Esc closes.
answers.move: Use WASD or the arrows: W and S walk, A and D turn.
answers.interact: Walk up to a building and press E to enter.
answers.help: Press H at any time to see all the keys.
answers.mouse: Mouse and touch are optional: the on-screen buttons do the same as the keys.
answers.unknown: I can't answer that yet. Try asking about the mode, the chat, how to walk or how to enter a building.
